title: 21 CFR Part 11 & EU MDR Article 10 Compliant Audit Package
regulatoryComplianceStatement: This record package adheres strictly to US FDA Title 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures, Annex 11 EU GMP, and PMDA ministerial regulations.

events.details: Initiated change order to migrate sterilization method from EO to Gamma Radiation across CS-100 product line.
Identified 12 directly impacted labels across US, EU, and Japan. Computed 100% symbol substitution required (STERILE EO -> STERILE R).
Flagged non-conformance: Japanese PMD Act Kanji warning omission '再滅菌禁止' and Secondary Carton GS1-128 expiration date mismatch (AI 17: 290831 vs text: 2029-09-30).
Placed workflow stage on REGULATORY_REVIEW hold pending injection of Japanese warning block and barcode reconciliation.
Auto-staged corrected artwork incorporating STERILE R symbol, synchronized GS1 DataMatrix AI(17) barcode, and formatted 7.5pt Kanji warning block.
